obfuscation_indicators: not material to any period presented
risk_summary: The excerpt presents strong, highly quantified revenue and profit growth, with a generally confident tone. Key risks include reliance on dealer inventory increases and demand conditions, rising material and freight costs, tariffs, regional economic uncertainty, and accounting estimates related to taxes and valuation allowances. Repeated explanations of dealer inventories and chart descriptions add boilerplate but do not materially obscure the disclosed figures.
